mutate_comment: Mutates only src/ai/** and src/showcase/** — the same 'clean logic, fast
tests' seam docs/test-quality-recommendations.md calls out as the ideal
Stryker target, not the whole backend. Excludes the entrypoint/CLI files
already excluded from coverage in vitest.config.ts (they're env/Postgres/
S3/Chromium wiring with no pure logic of their own — see that file's
per-entry comments for why each one is excluded) and *.d.ts. src/skills/
is Markdown, not .ts, so it's out of scope by construction, not by an
incremental_comment: Off by default (config is shared verbatim by CI's mutation.yml, which
never persists reports/stryker-incremental.json between runs — no
actions/cache step and the artifact upload only covers reports/mutation/
— so `true` here would just be dead weight in CI: every run rebuilds
from scratch anyway). Left as a local-only convenience: run
`npx stryker run --incremental` yourself to get incremental speedups
across your own local re-runs; the resulting incrementalFile stays
gitignored (see .gitignore) and is never shared with CI.
